lines.zh: 我挪动时，整座山都在移。
lines.en: When I move, the whole hill moves.

lines.zh: 我每压下一步，地面就塌一块。
lines.en: Each step of mine collapses a patch of ground.

lines.zh: 我从这片坡走到那片坡。
lines.en: I shift from one slope to the next.

lines.zh: 我的身体拖过草地，草全倒了。
lines.en: My body drags across the grass and flattens it.
When I move, the wind changes course.
I crush a ledge of rock.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地朝声音那边挪。
lines.en: I shift slowly toward the sound.

lines.zh: 我经过时，石子都陷进肉里。
lines.en: As I pass, pebbles sink into my flesh.

lines.zh: 我在坡上停住，喘得像风箱。
lines.en: I stop on the slope, breathing like a bellows.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，土都翻了起来。
lines.en: Where I pass, the soil is turned up.

lines.zh: 我伏在山脊上，像一座肉做的丘。
lines.en: I lie on the ridge, a hill made of flesh.

lines.zh: 我身上的部分在互相挪动。
lines.en: Parts of me shift against each other.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地呼吸，整片地都在起伏。
lines.en: I breathe slowly, and the ground rises and falls.
Several places on me are pulsing.

lines.zh: 我抬起来一点，又塌下去。
lines.en: I lift a little, then sag.

lines.zh: 我不出声，只有低沉的声音。
lines.en: I make no cry. Only a deep tone.

lines.zh: 我身上的肉在缝合处裂开又合。
lines.en: My flesh opens at the seams and closes.

lines.zh: 我感觉到很远的地方在动。
lines.en: I feel movement far away.
I wait, very patient.
I spread my body wider.

lines.zh: 我伏着，肉一块块换位置。
lines.en: I lie still while my flesh shifts place by place.

lines.zh: 我慢慢把一部分收了回来。
lines.en: I slowly draw part of myself back.
I am growing, though it does not show.
I sink lower toward the ground.

lines.zh: 我的表面有旧伤，已经不流血。
lines.en: Old wounds on my surface no longer bleed.

lines.zh: 我停在这个形状，等你过来。
lines.en: I hold this shape, waiting for you.
I turn my whole front toward you.

lines.zh: 你在我面前，只有一点点。
lines.en: Before me you are very small.

lines.zh: 我身上有很多眼，都在看你。
lines.en: Many eyes on me are all watching you.

lines.zh: 我抬起来，把影子落到你身上。
lines.en: I rise and let my shadow fall on you.
The ground begins to split beneath me.

lines.zh: 你不用跑，这片地都是我的。
lines.en: No need to run. This whole field is mine.

lines.zh: 我把最厚的一块抬起来。
lines.en: I lift my thickest mass.
I have noted where you stand.

lines.zh: 我身上的裂口朝你张开。
lines.en: The splits in my flesh open toward you.

lines.zh: 你手上那点东西太轻了。
lines.en: What you hold is too light.

lines.zh: 我伸出一部分去试你的距离。
lines.en: I extend a part of myself to test your distance.
I push my shadow under your feet.

lines.zh: 我掉了一块肉，没有感觉。
lines.en: A piece of flesh comes off. I feel nothing.

lines.zh: 我晃了一下，整片地都在动。
lines.en: I sway, and the whole ground moves.
I make a lower sound.
I retreat a very little.
I cover the wound.
All my eyes turn to the wound.

lines.zh: 我慢慢把摊开的身体收回。
lines.en: I slowly draw my spread body back in.
Part of me stops moving.
I know you hurt me.
I grow a new piece.
This is of no use to me.
You set it down. I do not move.
I did not even look at it.
That hint of sweetness does not register.
It is lost somewhere on me.
I look at you again.
Too small a morsel to stir me.
Hold it as long as you like. I will not move.

lines.zh: 地上那点东西，我绕开了。
lines.en: I shift around that little thing on the ground.
I take the whole of it in.

lines.zh: 你撞上来，像撞进一堆肉里。
lines.en: You hit me as if into a heap of flesh.
You hit me and rebound half a step.

lines.zh: 你退开时，鞋上沾了东西。
lines.en: As you pull back, something clings to your boot.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，地面塌了。
lines.en: We collide; the ground gives way.
I lift a little, then drop.
Part of me touches you.
I am not angered at all.
I shift my mass to the other side.

lines.zh: 你踩到的地方开始下陷。
lines.en: Where you stepped begins to sink.

lines.zh: 你撞进我里面，陷到膝盖。
lines.en: You walk into me and sink to the knee.
Another moves in the distance.

lines.zh: 我们靠在一起，边缘化开了。
lines.en: We press together and our edges melt.
We trade a large piece.

lines.zh: 我们一起把这座坡压平。
lines.en: Together we flatten this slope.
We rise and fall at the same moment.

lines.zh: 我们贴在一起，合成一块。
lines.en: We press together and become one mass.

lines.zh: 我们之间长出了新的东西。
lines.en: Something new grows between us.

lines.zh: 我们分开了，各自散到一边。
lines.en: We part and spread apart.

lines.zh: 它带走了一点我的形状。
lines.en: It takes some of my shape with it.

lines.zh: 这片地现在属于我们两个。
lines.en: This ground belongs to both of us now.

lines.zh: 我用一层薄肉把它盖住。
lines.en: I cover it with a thin layer of flesh.
I cover it with part of myself.
It sinks into my surface.

lines.zh: 它从我身上滑下去，落地。
lines.en: It slides off me and hits the ground.
Too hard. I give up on it.
I wrap it up and digest it slowly.
I have no hands. Only flesh to carry it.
It does not dissolve inside.
I leave it outside me.
I pay it no mind.
You have walked in.

lines.zh: 整座坡都朝你的方向倾。
lines.en: The whole slope tips toward you.
Part of me arrives first.

lines.zh: 我身上的洞口一齐朝向你。
lines.en: Every opening in me turns your way.
The cracks in the ground point at you.

lines.zh: 我身上所有的眼都对着你。
lines.en: Every eye on me is on you.
I raise my body.
I am in no hurry. You cannot leave.

lines.zh: 你落脚的地方我已经标下。
lines.en: I have marked where you plant your feet.
I gather myself; the ground shakes.
Did you hear that low sound.
All this ground answers to me.
Wherever you go, I can reach.
I have crushed the way back.

lines.zh: 我的影子把整个场地盖住。
lines.en: My shadow covers the whole arena.
You stand among the cracks.

lines.zh: 我发出一声，石头都在跳。
lines.en: I sound, and the stones jump.

lines.zh: 我开始把身体向你那边挪。
lines.en: I begin shifting my mass your way.

lines.zh: 整座坡都记下了你的重量。
lines.en: The whole slope has your weight noted.
I save the last step for now.
I press in bit by bit.

lines.zh: 你跑得再快，也没有这片地大。
lines.en: Run as you might, you cannot outrun my ground.
I do not chase. I block the way.
You cut me and take a piece of flesh.
I squeeze you toward the middle.
The ground splits, and the cracks travel toward you.
I do not roar. I only sound low.
You back to the wall; the wall is collapsing too.
My eyes follow you constantly.
I spread my body wider.
The ground under you grows thin.
I begin drawing some of myself in.
You should not stand on a crack.

lines.zh: 我把空隙一点一点吃掉。
lines.en: I eat up the gap bit by bit.
Your breathing quickens.
I have grown another measure.
A sound rolls in my chest.
This space is shrinking.

lines.zh: 你每一步都踩在我的边上。
lines.en: Every step you take lands on my edge.

lines.zh: 我马上就要压到你身上。
lines.en: I am about to come down on you.
I press down with my whole mass.
I extend a mass and strike you.
The ground splits beneath me.

lines.zh: 我有一部分卷住了你的腿。
lines.en: Part of me wraps your leg.
The piece you cut off is still moving.
I knock you off your feet.
I rise and slam down.
The shock throws you back three steps.
I push you toward the crack.
Part of me is under your feet.
My weight comes down on you.
I squeeze in from the side.

lines.zh: 我压下去，你的膝盖弯了。
lines.en: I press down and your knees buckle.
I press you into the soil.
The whole floor begins to bulge.

lines.zh: 我从土里长出来，一层一层。
lines.en: I rise out of the soil, layer by layer.

lines.zh: 山坡上多了一堆会动的东西。
lines.en: A moving heap has appeared on the hillside.
I open one eye first.
I split the ground open.
The hillside bulges and begins to breathe.
My shadow reaches the ground first.
My first sound is very low.

lines.zh: 我开始感觉周围的一切。
lines.en: I begin to feel everything around me.
I turn toward where the living are.
I lift my body into the air.
A piece of the slope has caved in.
Soil still falls off me.
I am the only one on this ground.
I begin spreading myself out.

lines.zh: 我的眼一个接一个睁开。
lines.en: My eyes open one after another.

lines.zh: 我开始朝最近的动静移动。
lines.en: I begin moving toward the nearest stir.
I crush a stone.
I am here, and so the ground is mine.
I wait to see who dares come first.

lines.zh: 火烧着我的肉，我抬起来躲。
lines.en: Fire burns my flesh; I rise away from it.

lines.zh: 我整个砸下来，地面凹成深坑。
lines.en: I crash down and the ground becomes a pit.

lines.zh: 水漫过我的身体，我动得很慢。
lines.en: Water covers me; I move very slowly.
The blast tears a great piece out of me.

lines.zh: 细小的东西扎在我身上，很多。
lines.en: Small things stick into me. Many of them.
That light burns inside me.

lines.zh: 我太久没吃到东西，开始缩。
lines.en: Too long unfed; I begin to shrink.

lines.zh: 雷打在我身上，整片地都亮了。
lines.en: Lightning hits me; the whole ground lights up.
Darkness draws the whole slope away.
